description: An app's frame: a sidebar with your brand, navigation and footer, a top bar that stays put, and the page scrolling under it. On large screens the sidebar collapses to a rail of icons, naming each on hover or focus, and can remember that in a cookie; on phones and tablets it slides in from the menu button, over a dimmed page that waits inert until it closes. Takes an accordion menu with icons. Works inside Livewire components.
